exposure: Intravenous remifentanil via patient-controlled analgesia (PCA) at a fixed dose
Intravenous remifentanil via PCA at an elevated dose during the active phase of the first stage of labor
outcome: Maternal numerical rating scale (NRS) pain score
cohort: The study included 115 parturients with contraindications to epidural analgesia who were willing to receive systemic labor analgesia.
finding: An elevated intravenous dosage of remifentanil with PCA during the active phase in the first stage of labor is safer and more effective for labor analgesia than a fixed-dosage regimen.
